Pumps: Supply & delivery at site brand new, best efficient make approved by the Board horizantal split case centrifugal pumps conforming to IS 5120 and the following. a. Duty condition: Capable of delivering 100 LPS / 360 m3/hr of Treated/Turbid water containing turbidity upto 3000 ppm against a total head of 110 m during solo operationb) Speed: Duty condition should be met at 1450 RPM.
c) Shutt off head: Min 110 % & Max 130 % of the specified head.
d) Material of construction: 
 1) Casing- Cast Iron 
 2) Impellor - CF 8M 
 3) Shaft- Stainless steel shaft- SS 410 
 4) Stuffing Box- Graphite Asbestos packing 
 5) Wear Rings- Phosphor Bronze 
 6) Gland- Cast Iron 
 7) Inter Stage Ring- Phosphor Bronze 
 8) Shaft Sleeve & Nuts- SS 410 
 9) Neck ring- SS 410
e) Driving end bearing: Grease lubricated roller/ball/ journal bearing
f) Non driving end bearing: Grease lubricated deep groove ball bearing as well as journal bearing or deep groove ball bearng only.
g) Coupling: Suitable size vibration proof flexible coupling with coupling guard, as recommended by the manufacturer of pump, for coupling to motor.
h) Base plate: Heavy duty common CI/MS base plate for pump and motor wth suitable Isection girders, channels, plates, bolts & nuts etc. i.Bearings shall be provided with RTDs for temperature measurements.Features of Construction.Type of pump: Horizantal split case.Type of sealing: stuffing box.Type of coupling - Direct, Flexible, Heavy duty.NOTE: 1.The duty condition of the pump should be at BEP or to the left of the BEP.2.The pump is required to work at an altitude of 650 m. above MSL and at a max. ambient temperature of 45 degree C. 3.The Board reserves the right to select any stipulated make of pump. 4.The loading for low efficient pump wll be done based on the excess power consumed by it over a period of 15 years, when compared to the best efficient pump. IS 5120 : Technical requirement for rotodynamic special purpose pumps.IS 9137 : Code for accetpance test for contrifugal mixed flow & axial flow pumps.IS 10981 : Specification for performance test.

Motor: Minimum 240 HP or Suitable HP Supply and delivery of any Board approved make soild Shaft squirrel cage induction Motor, CACA type, F class insulation suitable for operation on voltage mentioned below 3 phase 50 cycles per second with voltage variation of 10% and frequency of 3%, suitable for direct coupling with HSC pumps ,as per latest revision of IS 325, IS 4722 and other relevant IS specifications to meet the power requirement of pumps suitable for following duties, specifications and confirming to detailed specifications .Technical Details.Minimum KW Rating of Motor 450 KW, 1500 rpm( Syn).Supply Voltage 3.3 kV 10% to -10%.Supply frequency 50 Hz 3% to -3%. Combination of frequency and voltage-10%. Insulation class Class F and temperature rise as per class B. Cable termination details - Al conductor, XLPE insulated, armoured 3.3 kV (UE) grade cable. Cable termination box protection class IP 55Space Heater - 230 V space heater .Bearing temperature sensing - Required at both ends. Winding temp. sensing - 6 Nos. required for each motor. Earthing conductor - GI strip as per the sizes specified.Efficiency - Should be same within 75 % to 100 % load. Method of Starting - With Soft Starter.Cushion : 15% more than power required by the pump.at duty point and 10% more than the max power required by the pump which ever is higher. Terminal box for space heater. Terminal box for bearing temperature. Terminal Box for winding temperature. Earthing terminals with earthing pads -2 Nos. Mounting dimensions as per ISS 2223 or NEMA standards. Code & Standards :IS 325 : Induction Motors.IS 4691 : Degrees of protection proivded by enclosures rotating electrical machinery. IS 4029 : Measurement and evaluation of bibration of rotating electrical mechines. Guide for testing 3 phase induction motors.

Earthing : Maintenance free earthing system to be installed for the protection including formation of suitable size pit in all soils. The earthing system shall consist of:
EARTH ELECTRODE : Earth electrode shall be MS material subsequent hot dip galvanisation of minimum 250 microns / GI tubes to ensure maximum conductivity. The technology shall be either pipe in pipe or pipe in flat. The space in between shall be filled with high conductive compound which resist the corroision. The length of the electrode shall be 3 mtrs .Minimum of 50 mm dia electrode shall be provided for pipe in pipe technology.
EARTH ENHANCEMENT COMPOND / Back fill compound: The compound used for backfilling the earth shall enhance the earth material conductivity . The compoundshall reduce the resistivity of the earth to less than 1 ohms. The compond shall be highly conductive and contain homogenous mixture of chemicals. It shall be environmental friendly, non corrosive, not explosive, not cause burns and irritation to eye, skin etc. The compond shall not contain bentonite, salt , charcoal and other dissolvable materials. The compound shall be insoluable in water and shall retain its moisture property uptoi the life of the electrode. The life of the electrode and pit shall not be less than 25 years without any maintainence. The quantity of compound shall not be less than 50 kgs/ pit.
EARTH PIT CHAMBER: The earth pit chamber size shall be 300 mm x 300 mm x 5 mm concrete chamber with concrete slab or cover. 
TESTING POINT: Earth pit testing point shall be provided at the suitable location and above ground level.
Testing shall be done after completion of installation. Final grid resistance of each area shall be measured and shall be within 1 ohm.
NOTE:-1) All the equipments, such as switchgears, transformers lighting arrestors shall be earthed by two seperate and distinct connection as per IE rules and as required by electrical inspectorate without any extra cost.
2) Necessary soil testing shall be carried out by the contractor at his own cost before carrying out the work.
3) Since, the earthing points of different equipments and fault level are interconnected , the contractor shall submit the calculations for no of pits required before executing the work.
4) The work also includes connecting the common point of earthing to the earth pit with necessary coupler/ Extothermic welding as per IE rules
NOTE:- All the equipments, such as switchgears, transformers lighting arrestors shall be earthed by two seperate and distinct connection with the earth cover as per IE rules and as required by electrical inspectorate without any extra cost.

Supply and fixing of GI earthing strip 50mmx 6mm size for equipment earthing of transformer switch gear, meters motors lighting arrestors etc. The strips shall be laid and connected to the earth pit .The Strips shall be sleeved and protected aganist mechanical damages.

The contractor should employ personnel to operate & maintain the pumpset and accessories during the trial run period and should train the Board/Municipal Staff to operate the pumpsets.
